editorial:
Imagine waking up with a burning need for revenge after your brother is murdered. That is exactly where you find Hamza, a determined cop who will do anything to take down the man responsible. He manages to get transferred to the Anti-Narcotics Administration just so he can get closer to the enemy. The vibe here is intense and gritty, focusing on the dangerous world of drug smuggling and police work. You will feel Hamza's frustration as he deals with a villain who not only killed his family but also tries to destroy his marriage by framing his wife for a crime she didn't commit.

What really works here is how the tension builds up as Hamza plays a cat-and-mouse game with Salem. The acting is solid and makes the stakes feel real, though some parts of the plot move a bit slow. If you love crime stories where the hero is pushed to his limit, you will enjoy this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the action details. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Hamza finally corners the villains and clears his wife's name. He manages to expose the lies told by the drug dealers and brings them to justice. After a tense battle, the man who killed his brother is stopped for good. It wraps up with Hamza finding peace knowing he protected his family and cleaned up the streets, giving the story a satisfying and happy conclusion.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves police thrillers and revenge stories.
